catalog.applies_to: Mistral AI as a creator of the model families it trains and announces.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where Mistral AI publishes primary release information; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make Mistral AI a pilot creator.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Mistral AI's official news index; authoritative for its model and research announcements.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-27: HTTP 200, <title>Latest news | Mistral</title>, on the Mistral-owned mistral.ai host. The index carried Mistral, Magistral, Devstral and Pixtral posts. https://mistral.ai/news redirects to the trailing-slash form, which is why the canonical path is recorded with it.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Mistral AI's developer documentation; authoritative for the API model identifiers it exposes and their stated limits. allowed_paths is bounded to /getting-started/, the section that carries the model overview and the only one checked; widening it is a further human decision, not a run's.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-27: HTTP 200 at the docs root, <title>Documentation - Mistral AI</title>. /getting-started/models/models_overview/ returned HTTP 200 and carried mistral-* model identifiers.

source_catalog.trust_notes: The Mistral AI organization on Hugging Face; authoritative for the model cards and open weights Mistral publishes itself. Adds no new origin — huggingface.co is already trusted — and exists to bound link-following to the org. Third-party re-uploads of Mistral weights are not first-party and are not covered.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-27: HTTP 200, and https://huggingface.co/api/organizations/mistralai/overview reported "name":"mistralai", "fullname":"Mistral AI_" with "isVerified":true. The org listing carried mistralai/Mistral-Large-3-675B-Base-2512, mistralai/Ministral-3-8B-Instruct-2512 and mistralai/Devstral-2-123B-Instruct-2512.

deferred_origins.reason: Authenticated console. Not reachable as a public primary source, so nothing about it could be verified.

ambiguities.topic: 'Mistral' names both the organization and a family
ambiguities.note: Mistral AI is the creator; Mistral 7B and Mistral Large are models. The two share a word and sources use it loosely.
ambiguities.guidance: Keep the organization and the family as separate entities. Do not fold a release into the organization because the name matches.

ambiguities.topic: Open-weight releases and API-only releases sit side by side
ambiguities.note: Some Mistral models ship weights on Hugging Face; others exist only behind the API, and the two sets overlap without being identical.
ambiguities.guidance: Record availability from the source that states it. Absence of a model from the Hugging Face org is not evidence that it is API-only, and presence there is not evidence that it is the same release the API exposes under a similar name.

ambiguities.note: Le Chat is an assistant built on Mistral models and is often discussed as though it were one.
ambiguities.guidance: Record it as a product entity, separate from any release. Attribute capabilities to a specific model only where the source does.

ambiguities.note: Mistral models are served by cloud platforms other than Mistral's own API.
ambiguities.guidance: A serving platform is a separate entity from the creator and from the model. Being served somewhere is never evidence of who trained the model.
